clips.title: The story
paras: Apothecary Renferrel is a prominent member of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Tasked with advancing the Forsaken's alchemical endeavors, he coordinates extensive field research into the region's corrupted wildlife and undead threats. Travelers through Silverpine frequently assist him with gathering volatile reagents and investigating dangerous Scourge remnants.

Operating out of the Sepulcher, Renferrel serves as one of the Royal Apothecary Society's chief field researchers in Silverpine Forest. While Undercity houses the grand laboratories and high leadership of the society, Renferrel handles the practical, muddy work of securing native biological specimens, refining potent concoctions, and analyzing the grim ecology of Lordaeron's western border.
